normal: Default arrival rates; every task has an input age and a freshness bound.
monsoon_burst: Urgent tasks arrive 6× faster for up to 20 min on half the gateways; early warnings 60% recall, 39% precision.
heat_wave: Urgent tasks arrive 2.5× faster everywhere for half the run; forecast warnings 90% recall, 80% precision.
cloud_disconnection: The cloud is unreachable for 30 min (or half the run).
fog_failure: One fog server is down for 20 min (or a third of the run).

effective_deadline_success_rate: Effective deadlines met (deadline or data freshness)
autonomy_ratio: Urgent tasks completed locally (edge or fog)

hypotheses.statement: AURA raises urgent deadline success and freshness compliance over the baselines under burst and failure scenarios.
hypotheses.how: Counts of baselines AURA is significantly better than, not different from, or worse than, on urgent deadlines met and on stale decisions.

hypotheses.statement: Anticipatory reservation beats static reservation during surges.
hypotheses.how: AURA against AURA with static reservation, on urgent deadlines met and decision value.

hypotheses.statement: Under cloud disconnection AURA completes more urgent work locally (autonomy ratio).
hypotheses.how: AURA against each baseline on the autonomy ratio.

hypotheses.statement: The strategic tier lowers energy and cost compared with single-tier AURA and edge-ward placement without hurting urgent deadlines.
hypotheses.how: AURA against single-tier AURA and edge-ward on energy and cloud cost, and on urgent deadlines met (which must not be worse).
